title: Jewish Food pack
description: This Mod Adds Jewish food into minecraft! for jewish people mostly.
body:
Hey guys, this is a mod i made alone (solo dev) pretty basic but, it was annoying to me that my religious food wasnt in minecraft, so i decided to make it in-game! and if someone has any ideas make sure to contact me! and btw im starting to make more mods and way more harder so I'll update yall!
